## Validation and assumptions

The strategy retrieved all **5/5 prior-review benchmark records** and **2/2 records screened in during development**. These are relative recall figures, not sensitivity; there was no held-out validation set. The user supplied no seed articles. The query uses an Entrez entry-date bound through **2023-03-31**, with no publication-date limit.

I followed the eligibility criteria in treating self-efficacy as an eligible outcome. Broad simulation headings and high-fidelity simulation terms were retained to favor recall; they may bring in non-virtual or manikin-based studies that require screening. One benchmark study included both nursing and medical students with combined results, so check its population applicability at full text.
